source: https://playgroup.gg (Commander games tracked in the Playgroup app and Playgroup Live); figures copied by hand from the public pages, not scraped
notes: Precon win rates are for stock decklists against whatever the rest of the table played, normalised to a 4-player baseline where 25% is even; a precon needs at least 20 stock games from 10 pilots to be listed.
Seat win rates come from 257,261 untreated four-player games (turn-order experiment page).
Mulligan and opening-hand figures come from 189,535 opening hands and 1,608,359 finished games (how-many-lands page); game length is in rounds (each player's turn once).
